_comment: Copy to transfer.json (gitignored) and fill in your workstation. Every key can be overridden by AK3D_WS_<KEY> or a transfer.py flag.
_host: Either a ~/.ssh/config Host alias (leave user/port empty and let ssh resolve them) or a bare hostname/IP with user + port spelled out here.
_remote_root: Absolute path on the workstation; each capture lands in <remote_root>/<TIMESTAMP>/.
